issues.description: The problem statement requires Book.genres to be an optional array of Genre (so uncategorized books can have genres == nil). In the solution repository the Book struct declares genres as a non-optional [Genre], which contradicts the specification and is further contradicted by code that attempts to initialize a Book with genres: nil. This mismatch prevents following the specification and would cause compilation/runtime issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Book.genres property optional to match the specification: declare it as let genres: [Genre]? in the Book struct. Ensure all code that constructs or uses books accounts for the optional (e.g. use optional binding when printing genres). This preserves the intended design that uncategorized books have genres == nil and keeps all fields as let constants.
